//! code-minimap: render a compact braille "minimap" of a text file.

mod cli;
mod completion;
mod core;
mod row;
mod usage;

use std::ffi::OsString;
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::{self, BufRead, BufReader, BufWriter, ErrorKind, Write};
use std::process;

use crate::cli::build_cli;
use crate::completion::Shell;
use crate::core::{Encoding, Options, Renderer};

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<OsString> = std::env::args_os().collect();
    let mut cmd = build_cli();
    let matches = match cmd.try_get_matches_from_mut(&args) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(err) => usage::fix_suggestion_usage(&cmd, &args, err).exit(),
    };

    if let Some(sub) = matches.subcommand_matches("completion") {
        let shell = sub
            .get_one::<String>("shell")
            .and_then(|s| Shell::from_name(s))
            .expect("shell argument is required");
        let mut cmd = build_cli();
        let stdout = io::stdout();
        let mut out = stdout.lock();
        completion::generate(shell, &mut cmd, "code-minimap", &mut out);
        return;
    }

    let hscale = *matches.get_one::<f64>("hscale").unwrap_or(&1.0);
    let vscale = *matches.get_one::<f64>("vscale").unwrap_or(&1.0);
    let padding = matches.get_one::<usize>("padding").copied();
    let encoding = match matches.get_one::<String>("encoding") {
        Some(v) if v.eq_ignore_ascii_case("utf8") => Encoding::Utf8,
        _ => Encoding::Utf8Lossy,
    };
    let file = matches.get_one::<String>("file").cloned();

    let opts = Options {
        hscale,
        vscale,
        padding,
        encoding,
    };

    if let Err(err) = run(file.as_deref(), &opts) {
        if err.kind() == ErrorKind::BrokenPipe {
            process::exit(0);
        }
        eprintln!("code-minimap: {}", err);
        process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run(file: Option<&str>, opts: &Options) -> io::Result<()> {
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut out = BufWriter::new(stdout.lock());
    match file {
        Some(path) => {
            let reader = BufReader::new(File::open(path)?);
            render(reader, &mut out, opts)?;
        }
        None => {
            let stdin = io::stdin();
            let reader = stdin.lock();
            render(reader, &mut out, opts)?;
        }
    }
    out.flush()
}

fn render<R: BufRead, W: Write>(reader: R, out: &mut W, opts: &Options) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut renderer = Renderer::new(opts, out);
    match opts.encoding {
        Encoding::Utf8 => {
            for line in reader.lines() {
                renderer.begin_line()?;
                let line = line?;
                renderer.feed(&line);
            }
        }
        Encoding::Utf8Lossy => {
            let mut reader = reader;
            let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
            loop {
                buf.clear();
                let n = reader.read_until(b'\n', &mut buf);
                // Account for the line (for row bookkeeping) before inspecting
                // the read result, mirroring how an enumerated line iterator
                // behaves when it yields an error item.
                let n = match n {
                    Ok(0) => break,
                    Ok(n) => {
                        renderer.begin_line()?;
                        n
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        renderer.begin_line()?;
                        return Err(e);
                    }
                };
                let _ = n;
                let mut end = buf.len();
                if end > 0 && buf[end - 1] == b'\n' {
                    end -= 1;
                    if end > 0 && buf[end - 1] == b'\r' {
                        end -= 1;
                    }
                }
                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..end]);
                renderer.feed(&text);
            }
        }
    }
    renderer.finish()
}

//! code-minimap: render a compact braille "minimap" of a text file.

mod cli;
mod completion;
mod core;
mod row;
mod usage;

use std::ffi::OsString;
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::{self, BufRead, BufReader, BufWriter, ErrorKind, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process;

use crate::cli::build_cli;
use crate::completion::Shell;
use crate::core::{Encoding, Options, Renderer};

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<OsString> = std::env::args_os().collect();
    let mut cmd = build_cli();
    let matches = match cmd.try_get_matches_from_mut(&args) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(err) => usage::fix_suggestion_usage(&cmd, &args, err).exit(),
    };

    if let Some(sub) = matches.subcommand_matches("completion") {
        let shell = sub
            .get_one::<String>("shell")
            .and_then(|s| Shell::from_name(s))
            .expect("shell argument is required");
        let mut cmd = build_cli();
        let stdout = io::stdout();
        let mut out = stdout.lock();
        completion::generate(shell, &mut cmd, "code-minimap", &mut out);
        return;
    }

    let hscale = *matches.get_one::<f64>("hscale").unwrap_or(&1.0);
    let vscale = *matches.get_one::<f64>("vscale").unwrap_or(&1.0);
    let padding = matches.get_one::<usize>("padding").copied();
    let encoding = match matches.get_one::<String>("encoding") {
        Some(v) if v.eq_ignore_ascii_case("utf8") => Encoding::Utf8,
        _ => Encoding::Utf8Lossy,
    };
    let file = matches.get_one::<PathBuf>("file").cloned();

    let opts = Options {
        hscale,
        vscale,
        padding,
        encoding,
    };

    if let Err(err) = run(file.as_deref(), &opts) {
        if err.kind() == ErrorKind::BrokenPipe {
            process::exit(0);
        }
        eprintln!("code-minimap: {}", err);
        process::exit(1);
